subject: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form for LumenGrid - action grid & initial redlines
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@lumengrid.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form for LumenGrid - action grid & initial redlines

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, attaching a clean copy of Redwood's standard MSA (Redwood_MSA_v2.docx) and an initial order-form template so your procurement and legal teams have something concrete to work from.

High-level asks from our side to keep the onboarding timeline moving:
- Can you share the LumenGrid billing contact and PO cadence?
- Any residency / data residency constraints we should flag now? (regions, EU-only, etc.)
- List of any required vendor docs (SOC 2 type II, ISO, specific attestations) and the best contact for those requests.

Proposed next steps:
1) You review attached order form and return any party details and high-level exceptions by EOD Friday.
2) If LumenGrid has redline preferences, we can take those and have legal run an initial review within 48 hours.
3) We'll prepare a short action grid (owners + SLAs) and loop in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (onboarding) to coordinate.

If it's easier, happy to set a 30-min follow-up with procurement + legal this week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2.docx (MSA), LumenGrid_OrderForm_Draft.pdf (Order Form template)

From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@lumengrid.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumengrid.com
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form for LumenGrid - action grid & initial redlines

Karthik —

Appreciate the docs and the clear plan. Quick answers up front:
- Billing contact: procurement@lumengrid.com (POs are monthly; we use Net 45 in our system).
- Data residency: primary is US, but we need EU-only for a subset of customers; will flag which line items after we review the order form.
- Vendor docs: we need SOC 2 Type II report, and proof of encryption-at-rest for customer data. I can share our vendor checklist (attached) and loop in our legal if redlines are substantive.

Initial questions while I review:
1) Can Redwood accept Net 45 if we add a short clause in the order form (billing cadence section)?
2) Any objections to an EU-data residency exhibit for scoped customers?

I'll take a first pass on the order form and return comments by Thursday EOD. If we expect legal-level redlines, I'll put a call on the calendar for Friday with our counsel.

Best,
Sarah Connors
Head of Procurement | LumenGrid
sarah.connors@lumengrid.com

Attachments: LG_Vendor_Checklist.xlsx (vendor evidence checklist)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@lumengrid.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form for LumenGrid - action grid & initial redlines

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick responses, and for the vendor checklist. Copying Marissa from Onboarding so we have the right owners aligned. A few notes from Legal to smooth the review:

- Net 45: Redwood is generally fine with Net 45 on the order form; we prefer it captured in the Order Form billing section rather than the MSA. Please include the exact billing language your AP team needs and we will mirror it.
- EU-data residency: we can support an EU-data residency exhibit scoped to specific product lines/customers. We'll need to confirm the hosting region and controls; Marissa, can you capture the technical residency/provisioning owners?
- SOC 2 and encryption: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and an encryption-at-rest statement. We typically provide a secure link for SOC 2 artifacts; Sarah, please let us know if you need the full report or a summary.

To keep this tight, I will:
1) Triage any redlines you return tomorrow and mark them as Fast-Track (commercial terms) vs Legal-Flag (MSA core clauses).
2) Produce an "action grid" with owners and suggested SLAs after your comments come in.

If you prefer, we can do a quick 20-minute triage with your legal to align on the redline approach (track vs comment).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

--

Thanks — quick note from Onboarding: once we get the returned order form with party details, onboarding will prepare a short technical acceptance checklist and an EU-exhibit template if you identify specific line items that must be EU-only.

Action grid (initial):
- Procurement/billing: Sarah Connors / procurement@lumengrid.com — provide billing contact and PO cadence (Due: Thu 2027-07-08 EOD)
- legal redlines: Sarah's legal (TBD) -> submit redlines to kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com (triage within 48 hours)
- SOC2 & evidence: Kim to share secure SOC2 link after we receive vendor checklist (Due: Thu 2027-07-08)
- Technical residency: Marissa to capture hosting region and provisioning owners after order form review (Due: Fri 2027-07-09)

We'll mark any commercial-only asks for expedited routing. If you upload comments to the shared DocuSign/drive link, we'll consume them and prepare a consolidated redline package.

I'll pencil in a 30-min triage slot Friday 09:00 AM PT if that works for legal/procurement — Sarah, let me know if you prefer another time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
